title: SNIascore: Deep Learning Classification of Low-Resolution Supernova Spectra (Fremling et al.)

episodes.description: Build and select the SNIascore binary SN Ia classifier

chain.op: assemble 5550 SEDM spectra of 3463 BTS transients with BTS labels
split training (2018-03 to 2020-03 minus BTS18), validation (BTS18), testing (2020-03 to 2020-08)
interpolate to 3800-9150 A grid, 209 bins
median-normalise, divide by smoothed continuum, subtract one
grid of 1-5 BiLSTM-layer networks
hyperparameter grids (dropout, hidden units, learning rate, batch size)
train past overfitting, save every epoch
select optimal epoch and cuts on BTS18 by successful classifications at FPR 0% and 1%
replace BiLSTM layers with GRU in combinations, keep middle-GRU network
MC dropout 100 reruns for sigma
compare ROC with SNID and DASH, test on independent data

episodes.description: Build the SNIascore redshift regression network

chain.op: select SNe Ia with redshift known to three decimals (891 spectra)
augment to equalise redshift distribution (12810 spectra) with added noise
replace classification layers with regression layer
search forward/backward loss functions
select root MBE squared by residual fractions and linearity on BTS18
evaluate against host-galaxy and SNID redshifts

episodes.description: Live automated classification of one SEDM spectrum and TNS report

chain.op: SEDM observation triggered for BTS target
automated SEDM data reduction
preprocess spectrum
SNIascore score and sigma by 100 MC reruns
apply threshold (0.9 initially)
predict redshift and report SN Ia classification to TNS within about 10 minutes

episodes.description: Investigation of high-quality false positives in validation and testing sets

chain.op: list false positives at recommended cut
inspect spectrum quality and host contamination
inspect SNID matches at rlap>5
compare light-curve evolution and SN Ia light-curve models
conclude on likely class and main contaminant type
